text: Over the period of 2026-05-14 to 2026-05-20, ROBI handled a total of 129 orders, successfully delivering 42 while encountering warnings on 25 and failures on 62. The most common failure reason was "unknown" (48 times), affecting multiple orders. Orders #2 and #3 were particularly slow, taking up to 817 seconds for order #2. Given the high number of "unknown" failures, a suggestion would be to increase vigilance during initial [[detection]] phases, especially when picking items like pen, ball, water bottle, sock, and coffee mug, which are among the top items handled by ROBI.
